name: Skaven

specialRules.name: Skaven special skills
specialRules.text: Skaven Heroes with access to the Special skill table may choose from: Black Hunger, Tail Fighting, Wall Runner, Infiltration, Art of Silent Death.

specialRules.name: Black Hunger (skill)
specialRules.text: Declare at the start of own turn: +1 A and +D3" to total move for the turn; at end of turn suffer D3 S3 hits with no armour save possible.

specialRules.name: Tail Fighting (skill)
specialRules.text: May wield a shield, knife or sword with its tail: gains an extra attack with that weapon, or +1 to its armour save.

specialRules.name: Wall Runner (skill)
specialRules.text: Does not need to take an Initiative test when climbing walls and other sheer surfaces.

specialRules.name: Infiltration (skill)
specialRules.text: Set up after the opposing warband, anywhere out of enemy sight and more than 12" from any enemy model. If both sides infiltrate, each rolls a D6; lowest sets up first.

specialRules.name: Art of Silent Death (skill)
specialRules.text: Fights bare-pawed without penalty and counts as having two weapons (+1 A). Causes a critical hit on a To Wound roll of 9-12. Usable with Fighting Claws (+2 A instead of +1).

equipmentLists.name: Heroes equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: Assassin Adept, Black Skaven, Eshin Sorcerer

items.name: Weeping Blades
items.note: Per pair. Rare 9, Skaven only. Close combat, Strength as user. Pair: +1 attack. Venomous: permanently coated in black lotus; no other poison may be applied. Parry: count as swords for parrying.

items.name: Fighting Claws
items.note: Per pair. Rare 7, Skaven only. Close combat, Strength as user, no save modifier. Pair: +1 attack. Climb: +1 I for Climbing tests. Parry: may parry and re-roll a failed parry once, like sword and buckler. Cumbersome: may not use any other weapons in the entire battle.

items.name: Blowpipe
items.note: Rare 7, Skaven only. Range 8", S1, save modifier +1. Poison: natural 12 to hit wounds automatically; cannot cause critical hits. Positive save modifier: models with no save still get the worst possible save (6+ in d6). Stealthy: may fire while hidden without revealing position; target may take an Initiative test to spot the firer, ending hidden on a pass.

items.name: Warplock pistol
items.note: 70 gc for a brace. Rare 11, Skaven only. Range 8", S5, save modifier -3. Fire every other turn.

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any warrior within 6" may use his Leadership instead of their own.

specialRules.name: Perfect Killer
specialRules.text: Extra -1 modifier to any armour save against wounds he inflicts (shooting and close combat).

specialRules.name: Wizard
specialRules.text: Is a wizard and uses the Magic of the Horned Rat.

fighters.name: Night Runner
fighters.notes: Hero that buys from the Skaven Henchmen Equipment list.

fighters.name: Giant Rat
fixedEquipment: Natural weapons (never use armour or weapons)

specialRules.name: Pack size
specialRules.text: You can recruit as many Giant Rats as you wish.

fighters.name: Rat Ogre
fixedEquipment: Jaws, claws and brute force (never use weapons or armour)

specialRules.name: Stupidity
specialRules.text: Subject to stupidity unless a Skaven Hero is within 6".

conversionNotes: Blowpipe Poison: 'roll a 6 on the To Hit roll' converted to natural 12.
Art of Silent Death: critical hit on To Wound 5-6 converted to 9-12.
Blowpipe: printed example (5+ save becomes 4+ vs blowpipe; models with no save get 6+) left unconverted; +1 save modifier needs a d12 equivalent (6+ has no entry in the conversion table).
Infiltration roll-off (D6 each, lowest sets up first) left as printed; it is a plain roll-off, not a target number.
Black Hunger D3 values (+D3" move, D3 S3 hits) left as printed.
Skaven special skill table recorded as skill name 'Skaven Special'; ticked for all four hero types.
Night Runners are heroes but buy from the Henchmen Equipment list, as printed.
Weeping Blades, Fighting Claws and Warplock pistol are priced per pair/brace as printed; warplock brace (70 gc) is in the note only.
